examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Pick a suggestion, or type your own and press Enter; typing a suggestion's name selects it instead of creating a copy. The component is controlled: keep the selected values in state and update them from `onValueChange`.

examples.title: Preselected values
examples.description: Pass the starting selection as `value`. A value that is not one of the options, like Warm here, is shown as typed.

examples.title: Values and labels
examples.description: Each option has a stored `value` and a display `label`. Chips show the label, and `onValueChange` receives the values.

examples.title: Free text only
examples.description: Leave out `options` and it becomes a tag input: type, press Enter, and Backspace on an empty field removes the last tag.

examples.title: Create hint
examples.description: `createHintText` adds a line with an Enter key hint at the top of the open panel, so people know they can add their own.

examples.title: Helper text
examples.description: `helperText` sits under the field while it is closed and is linked to it with `aria-describedby`.

examples.title: Selection limit
examples.description: `maxItems` caps the selection. The panel states the limit and closes once it is reached; remove a chip to add another.

examples.title: Character limit
examples.description: `maxLengthPerItem` limits how long a created value can be and shows a live counter that turns red at the limit. Suggestions are stored whole. Set `showPerItemCharacterCounter={false}` to hide the counter.

examples.title: Restrict characters
examples.description: `sanitizeInput` strips characters as they are typed and `normalizeInput` tidies what is left. `onInvalidCharacters` and `onValidInput` tell you when to show and clear a message.

examples.title: Track the draft
examples.description: `onInputValueChange` reports the text being typed, so you can validate or search while it is still a draft.

examples.title: Summary display
examples.description: `triggerDisplay="summary"` shows the closed field as one comma-separated line instead of removable chips.

examples.title: Unavailable options
examples.description: An option with `disabled: true` is left out of the suggestions, and typing its name does not create it.

examples.title: Error
examples.description: `state="error"` draws the error border. Show your message under the field and point `aria-describedby` at it.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: `disabled` keeps the selection visible but locks the field, its chips and its suggestions.

examples.title: In a form
examples.description: A required field: submitting with nothing selected shows the error state and message, and choosing a value clears it.
